text:
rebecca-cs: Heads up — ACME prod is seeing sporadic 400/422 `invalid_embedding_dim` on /v1/embeddings and really bad 99p tail latency (about 5-8s). Blocks their search pipeline. sample traces: abc123, def456, ghi789. anyone seen this pattern?

anna-support: Ugh. Can you paste an example request + response and any logs you have? Also: are they mixing model variants (small vs large) in the same client?

rebecca-cs: Here's a sanitized example from the customer: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-small","input":["query text here"]}'
```
response they see intermittently: ```json
{"error":{"type":"invalid_embedding_dim","message":"expected 1536, got 1024"}}
```
They also show a 500 when latency spikes.

sam-eng-ml: That error screams "mixed-dimension coalesce" — if the batcher mixes a quantized/variant model or different model sizes you end up with inconsistent output dims. Are they switching model name per-call?

luis-eng-runtime: Adding logs from our runtime around the times for trace abc123: ```
[2026-02-28T12:34:56.123Z] dynbatch: coalesced=38 max_batch_size=64 coalesce_window_ms=12 route=embeddings/default
[2026-02-28T12:34:56.124Z] dynbatch: mixed_variant_detected=true variants=[text-embedding-3-small,text-embedding-3-large]
[2026-02-28T12:34:56.125Z] flush: payload_build_time=4.2s effective_batch=38
[2026-02-28T12:34:56.126Z] embed-exec: error=invalid_embedding_dim expected=1536 got=1024 trace=abc123
```
So two things: we coalesced a big mixed batch and the build/serialization jitter pushed execution into 4s+ which caused 500s for some callers.

priya-sre: Can reproduce locally by sending alternating requests to /v1/embeddings with two model names concurrently. I'm going to run a small probe to capture timings. Do you want me to post the repro script?

rebecca-cs: Yes please, the customer says the issue occurs when their ingestion workers and user-facing search hit the endpoint at the same time.

priya-sre: Repro script (short): ```bash
for i in {1..200}; do
  MODEL=$((i%2==0)) && MNAME="text-embedding-3-small" || MNAME="text-embedding-3-large"
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx" -d "{\"model\":\"$MNAME\",\"input\":[\"hello $i\"]}" &
  sleep 0.01
done
wait
```
This produces mixed_variant batches locally and occasional invalid_embedding_dim errors + 99p tail ~4-6s.

anna-support: Immediate customer workaround: 1) have each service (ingest vs search) pin a single model variant (avoid mixing) OR 2) set client-side `max_batch_size:1` / serialize requests during the short window. Both ugly but quick.

luis-eng-runtime: Longer-term fix: we should enforce stricter coalescing rules so the dynbatcher only coalesces requests when model signature (model name + quantization flags + expected_dim) matches. I'll open a PR to add a fast-path comparator and expose a metric `mixed_batch_count`. We can also short-circuit and flush mixed batches earlier to avoid 4s payload build time.

anna-support: I'll share the workaround with ACME and escalate. creating ticket now.

ops-bot: INCIDENT created: INC-2026-1234 assigned_to=eng-runtime severity=P2 links=[https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-1234]

luis-eng-runtime: assigning to @sam-eng-ml and @priya-sre. quick hotfix idea: when mixed_variant_detected -> split into sub-batches or fail fast with clear error instead of silently coalescing. That will prevent dimension mismatch and reduce tail latency.

rebecca-cs: customer prefers a config toggle they can set on their account to disable cross-variant coalescing while we roll the runtime fix. Is that something we can enable quickly?

sam-eng-ml: We can gate a tenant-level flag `coalesce_strict=true` in the router to disable cross-variant coalescing per-tenant. low-risk and doable this week.

anna-support: Action items: 1) tell ACME the temporary workaround (pin model or serialize). 2) enable `coalesce_strict=true` for ACME as a hotfix. 3) eng-runtime to land PR to detect+split mixed batches and add metric. 4) gather more traces (abc123/def456/ghi789) and attach to INC-2026-1234.

rebecca-cs: Will update ACME with that plan and ask for a short maintenance window. Thanks all — I'll follow up in ~1hr after customer sync. :thumbsup:
